text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Eishin Flash has a number
of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A hot spring getaway?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've held onto the ticket ever since Eishin
Flash
won it at the raffle. I suggest now
is a good time
to use it since her
schedule's calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is a valid point. Let's add the
vacation into
the schedule, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to rearrange all my plans to
work around
this, so I'll have to think
about when would be
best to—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But... I have already allocated that day
to do
some film study.
choice_data_list: 来週の休養日にあてるのは？

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: 場所は書いてないだろ？
場所は書いてないでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It does not, no. I did not indicate where,
exactly,
I should do my film study.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let's go to the hot spring on
that day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sorry. Were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had planned on doing few
hundred-second dips
in the water, but I
think I soaked for too long.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I did. I had forgotten how hot Japanese
hot
springs are...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could we step outside for a moment to
cool off?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The night air is so crisp...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No. In fact, I feel very comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hier bin ich Mensch, hier darf ich's sein...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A famous poem from Germany. I felt a
sudden
urge to recite it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I seem to be in a sentimental mood. The
heat
from the bath still has me feeling a
little
light-headed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What's worse is that I feel lax moments
like this
are actually... acceptable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I have you listen,
without
any judgment?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then please indulge me for a little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will continue striving to become the
right,
perfect version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it will most likely take my
entire life to
achieve that state of
perfection...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I cannot accept this flawed,
yet-in-progress
version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I wish for you to be at my
side.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am my own harshest critic. However, if
you are
there to validate my progress...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I can move forward.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
choice_data_list: いつでも君を認めてるよ
いつでも貴方を認めてるよ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The day we first met, I had pushed
myself too
hard and failed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But even that had meaning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After all, it was because I overexerted
myself for
the sake of reaching
perfection that I came to
meet you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This time spent together feels like a safe
haven
we built—just for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Eishin Flash and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
